The '''1971 Indonesian census''' was the second census of [[Indonesia]] as a sovereign state. It enumerated a total population of 119,208,229. Its population density during the 1971 census was {{Pop density|119208229|1904569|km2|prec=1|disp=num}} inhabitants/km<sup>2</sup>.{{sfn|Statistics Indonesia|2021a}}

It was the last and the only two Indonesian censuses held in a year ending with the number 1, the other the first [[1961 Indonesian census|1961 census]]. The following census held in [[1980 Indonesian census|1980]] and onwards held in a year ending with the number 0.
